m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Oh me, oh my, what is that terrible stench? It smells like an old litter box!
It's that riff-raff Vice-Chair Freeder associates with. It doesn't smell like my litter box. But of course, my litter has odor-control crystals...
So does mine! It also has superior clumping granules, so there! But let's bicker litter later. Right now, let's neutralize these interlopers!
You don't think we really stink, do you? I mean, we have been on the road for a while, but I think they're just being Qhatty. I hope, at least.
Either way, as soon as we get back to Kasra Palace, I'm taking a bath! Oh, I can't wait, Master! Let's hurry up and get this done.
Well, look what the dog dragged in! You must be the troublemakers Vice-Chair Freeder sent after this special artifact.
You should know that we no longer have need of the artifact. Yes, we've reached our own compromise, and by that, I mean, there won't be one.
Now, if you please, I would ask you to leave. If you don't please, then we will just have to make you.
I have to say, other than Freeder, the Sayameez are the snobbiest, most self-centered creatures in all Mirage. Now, where's that Goofang guy?
I can't believe this - the nerve of you people to just storm into my Laboratory. Have you no respect for Sayameez tradition? Of course not!
You are outsiders, unworthy in every aspect. We shouldn't even let people like you inside the walls. You only bring discord and violence.
In fact, I suspect it's your influence that's encouraged the Rebels. And it's just as well. When I bring you down, the Rebellion will fall too.
Where were you guys? I went out on a limb for this plan. Getting qhat-napped was not part of it. I hope you at least have this... artifact-thing?
You do? Fabulous. I'll take it. Come along, Father. Let's take this back to your Suite and talk to Miriam. Wizard, we'll see you there!
That wasn't so difficult now, was it? I've been telling you both, if you just sit down and have a civil conversation, compromise is possible.
After all that's transpired, you have little chance of finding support for your alliance. There's basically no hope for peace at this point.
He's right. I warned Freeder, but he wouldn't listen. When he came to tell Chairman Meow of his plan, the Sayameez Hardliners went ballistic!
Pardon me. Sorry to butt in, but I believe there is yet hope. The Chairman was open to possibility. It was Goofang who ruined everything.
Goofang and the Sayameez Hardliners took the Chairman and the Vice-Chair hostage. They're being held in Goofang's Laboratory.
I suspect, Wizard, that if you have this artifact and you were to liberate the Chairman, we still might be able to forge a compromise.
Then we'll go to the Laboratory straight away. We're not giving up. C'mon, Master. Goofang has no idea who he's messing with.
I have my doubts about whether this exercise is worth it, but if you are successful, you will still have my support, as promised.
